# Metrics

`GET /metrics` answers in the Prometheus text format and requires `Authorization: Bearer <METRICS_TOKEN>`;
an admin key is also accepted, and when `METRICS_TOKEN` is unset only an admin key can read it.

| Series | Type | Labels | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `gw_sessions` | gauge | `status` | Sessions currently in each status. |
| `gw_http_requests_total` | counter | `method`, `route`, `status` | HTTP responses, by method, route pattern and status (`unmatched` when no route matched). |
| `gw_http_request_duration_seconds` | histogram | `method`, `route` | Seconds from receiving an HTTP request to the end of its response, by method and route pattern. |
| `gw_events_total` | counter | `event` | Events received from WhatsApp, by event name. |
| `gw_events_skipped_total` | counter | `event` | Events the adapter could not map and dropped, by event name. |
| `gw_ordering_held_total` | counter | - | Inbound messages the order buffer held back to wait for earlier ones. |
| `gw_ordering_reordered_total` | counter | - | Inbound messages published in a different order than they arrived. |
| `gw_ordering_hold_seconds` | histogram | - | Seconds a held inbound message waited in the order buffer. |
| `gw_pipeline_errors_total` | counter | `stage` | Failures of the event pipeline, by stage (dedupe, store, publish, replay, event, policy). |
| `gw_send_total` | counter | `result` | Outbound sends, by result. |
| `gw_send_duration_seconds` | histogram | - | Seconds from taking a send job to its outcome. |
| `gw_send_queue_depth` | gauge | `session` | Send jobs waiting in the queue of each session. |
| `gw_webhook_deliveries_total` | counter | `result` | Webhook deliveries, by result: each attempt's outcome (`success`; `retry`, failed and will be tried again; `failed`, failed for the last time; `dropped`, the job ended without an attempt because its webhook is gone or disabled or the delivery was already made), `unlogged` (no row could be stored), `not_queued` (the job could not be queued) and `swept` (a pending row with no job to run it was sent to the dead letters by the retention sweep). |
| `gw_webhook_duration_seconds` | histogram | - | Seconds a webhook delivery attempt took. |
| `gw_wa_call_duration_seconds` | histogram | `op` | Seconds a call into whatsapp-web.js took, by operation. |
| `gw_wa_call_errors_total` | counter | `op`, `type` | Failed calls into whatsapp-web.js, by operation and error type. |
| `gw_watchdog_restarts_total` | counter | - | Sessions the watchdog restarted (a frozen browser, a start that never ended, memory). A browser that dies is not counted here: see gw_browser_recoveries_total. |
| `gw_browser_recoveries_total` | counter | `code` | Sessions the adapter found with their browser or page gone (killed, crashed, closed) and sent to reconnect, by code (BROWSER_DISCONNECTED, PAGE_CLOSED, PAGE_CRASHED, other). |
| `gw_auth_quarantined_total` | counter | - | Saved logins the gateway moved to quarantine on its own because WhatsApp refused them (the account was unlinked while the gateway was stopped). |
| `gw_logout_total` | counter | `reason` | Sessions WhatsApp Web logged out on its own, by the reason it gave (client_fatal, sync_fail, history_sync_timeout, account_locked, unspecified when it gave none, other). |
| `gw_wa_web_build_info` | gauge | `version` | Sessions running each WhatsApp Web build, by version (2.3000.<number>, or unknown). |
| `gw_wa_web_drift_errors_total` | counter | `kind`, `target` | Calls that failed because WhatsApp Web changed under the patch of whatsapp-web.js, by kind (signature: a function it no longer exports; lazy_module: a module no bundle loaded) and target (Module.function, or other). |
| `gw_policy_decisions_total` | counter | `rule`, `decision` | Decisions of the send policy that are not a plain allow at enqueue, by rule (`none` for an allow) and decision (allow, delay, reject). |
| `gw_policy_delay_seconds` | histogram | - | Seconds the send policy asked a job to wait. |
| `gw_suppressed_chats` | gauge | - | Chats on the suppression lists of all sessions. |
| `gw_socket_connections` | gauge | - | Socket.IO clients connected and authenticated. |
| `gw_socket_disconnects_total` | counter | `reason` | Socket.IO clients the gateway disconnected, by reason (slow_consumer: its packets queued past SOCKET_MAX_QUEUED_EVENTS; unauthorized: its key was revoked, expired or no longer allowed). |
| `gw_replay_write_failures_total` | counter | - | Events that could not be kept for socket replay (Redis down, or the event over the size limit); live delivery is not affected. |
| `gw_reconcile_recovered_total` | counter | - | Messages the reconciliation pass recovered after a reconnect. |

Histograms also expose the `_bucket`, `_sum` and `_count` series Prometheus derives from them.
Node.js and process metrics (`process_*`, `nodejs_*`) are exposed as well.
